_meta.purpose: Curated launch-option dictionary for slop-scraper. Maps well-known, STANDARDIZED flags (engine- or platform-level) to verified description / effect / usage_example. Fixes thin descriptions AND seeds the usage-docs columns (usage_example/effect) in one pass. See docs/slop-scraper-followthrough.md sec 6.
_meta.accuracy_policy: Only universal flags with a documented, stable meaning are included. Game-SPECIFIC flags are deliberately excluded because their meaning varies per title; leave those sourced or null. Never auto-generate meanings.
_meta.matching: Keys are exact command tokens. For PARAMETERIZED flags (takes a value, e.g. '-w', '-ResX=', '+fps_max'), match the flag token and substitute the user's value; usage_example shows a concrete value. 'aliases' lists equivalent spellings.
_meta.authority_note: risk_level/categories are intentionally omitted — slop-scraper's validation/metadata_tagging.py remains authoritative for those. 'category_hint' is an optional suggestion only.
_meta.confidence: high = documented and stable; medium = correct but with nuance/variation worth a human glance before shipping (see 'note').

sources.unity: Unity Manual — 'Standalone player command line arguments'
sources.unreal: Unreal Engine docs — 'Command-line arguments' / stock UE switches
sources.proton: Proton / DXVK / Feral GameMode / MangoHud project docs; ProtonDB

entries.description: Skips the Valve intro video played at launch.
entries.effect: Boots straight to the main menu, trimming a few seconds off startup.

entries.description: Runs the game in a window instead of fullscreen.
entries.effect: Launches windowed; pair with -noborder for borderless.

entries.description: Forces the game to run in fullscreen.
entries.effect: Overrides a saved windowed setting on launch.

entries.description: Runs the window without borders (borderless windowed).
entries.effect: Fullscreen-like window with fast alt-tab.

entries.description: Sets the horizontal resolution (width) in pixels.
entries.effect: Forces render width; usually paired with -h.

entries.description: Sets the vertical resolution (height) in pixels.
entries.effect: Forces render height; usually paired with -w.

entries.description: Sets the monitor refresh rate in hertz.
entries.effect: Forces the given refresh rate on launch.

entries.description: Launches the game at high CPU priority.
entries.effect: Can smooth frame times, but may starve other apps of CPU.

entries.description: Disables joystick/controller support at startup.
entries.effect: Slightly faster launch and lower memory use.

entries.description: Enables the in-game developer console.
entries.effect: Console can be opened in-game (default: ` / ~).

entries.description: Logs all console output to console.log in the game folder.
entries.effect: Writes a console log for troubleshooting.

entries.description: Caps the maximum frame rate.
entries.effect: Limits FPS to the given value (0 = uncapped).

entries.description: Sets the tickrate for a listen/local server.
entries.effect: Higher tickrate = more frequent server updates (local/community servers).
entries.note: Parameterized; affects locally hosted servers only.

entries.description: Resets video and performance settings to their defaults.
entries.effect: Overwrites current graphics settings on launch — remove after one run.

entries.description: Forces a DirectX feature level in Source games.
entries.effect: Applied on the FIRST launch after being set; remove it afterward or it re-resets settings each start.
entries.note: Review: value meanings vary (80/81/90/95); first-launch-only behavior.

entries.description: Disables the D3D9Ex code path in Source games.
entries.effect: A legacy compatibility toggle; can change alt-tab behavior. Results vary by system.
entries.note: Review: effect is system-dependent; describe neutrally.

entries.description: Toggles fullscreen for Unity games (1 = on, 0 = off).
entries.effect: Overrides the saved fullscreen preference.

entries.description: Sets the window/render width for Unity games.
entries.effect: Forces horizontal resolution.

entries.description: Sets the window/render height for Unity games.
entries.effect: Forces vertical resolution.

entries.description: Forces the Unity game to render with Direct3D 11.
entries.effect: Overrides the default graphics API.

entries.description: Forces the Unity game to render with Vulkan.
entries.effect: Can help or hurt depending on drivers/GPU.

entries.description: Forces the Unity game to render with OpenGL Core.
entries.effect: Uses the OpenGL backend instead of the default.

entries.description: Forces Direct3D 9 in older Unity games.
entries.effect: Legacy graphics backend; only meaningful on older Unity builds.
entries.note: Review: only supported by older Unity versions.

entries.description: Runs the Unity game in a borderless popup window.
entries.effect: Borderless windowed presentation.

entries.description: Forces Unity's resolution/configuration dialog to appear at launch.
entries.effect: Shows the settings dialog even if disabled by the developer.

entries.description: Sets the Unity quality level by name.
entries.effect: Selects a quality preset defined by the game.
entries.note: Review: valid level NAMES are defined per game.

entries.description: Runs the Unreal game with DirectX 11.
entries.effect: Selects the DX11 renderer.

entries.description: Runs the Unreal game with DirectX 12.
entries.effect: Selects the DX12 renderer; can reduce or add stutter depending on the title.

entries.description: Sets the horizontal resolution for Unreal games.
entries.effect: Forces render width.

entries.description: Sets the vertical resolution for Unreal games.
entries.effect: Forces render height.

entries.description: Skips Unreal's startup movies/intros.
entries.effect: Boots faster by skipping intro cinematics.

entries.description: Suppresses the splash screen shown while the game loads.
entries.effect: Hides the loading splash image.

entries.description: Disables texture streaming, loading textures at full resolution up front.
entries.effect: Can reduce texture pop-in at the cost of much higher VRAM use.

entries.description: Lets the Unreal game use all available CPU cores.
entries.effect: May improve performance on multi-core CPUs where the game under-utilizes cores.

entries.description: Forces Shader Model 4 (a lower feature level) in Unreal games.
entries.effect: Lower-fidelity rendering path; can help very old GPUs.
entries.note: Review: only relevant on older UE titles that support SM4.

entries.description: Sets a custom render width in id Tech games.
entries.effect: Use with '+set r_mode -1' to apply a custom resolution.

entries.description: Sets a custom render height in id Tech games.
entries.effect: Use with '+set r_mode -1' to apply a custom resolution.

entries.description: Caps the frame rate in id Tech games.
entries.effect: Limits FPS to the given value.

entries.description: Runs the game through Feral GameMode for a performance-tuned CPU governor.
entries.effect: Applies GameMode optimizations for the game's session (Linux/Steam Deck).

entries.description: Runs the game with the MangoHud performance overlay.
entries.effect: Shows FPS/frametime/temps on screen (Linux/Steam Deck).

entries.description: Makes Proton use WineD3D (OpenGL translation) instead of DXVK.
entries.effect: A compatibility fallback when DXVK misbehaves; usually slower.

entries.description: Disables esync under Proton.
entries.effect: A compatibility toggle for games that misbehave with esync.

entries.description: Disables fsync under Proton.
entries.effect: A compatibility toggle for games that misbehave with fsync.

entries.description: Enables DXVK async shader compilation.
entries.effect: Can reduce shader-compilation stutter, but may trip some anti-cheat and requires an async-capable DXVK.
entries.note: Anti-cheat risk — classifier should treat as caution/experimental.

entries.description: Enables NVAPI under Proton (needed for DLSS on NVIDIA).
entries.effect: Exposes NVAPI so DLSS and related features can work in Proton.
entries.note: Review: exact requirement varies by Proton version (GE vs stock).
